messages.content: Each paragraph of your response must end with the same word it started with, separate paragraphs with a newline.  Discuss how likely the predictions below are.  • Privacy will become a thing of the past. • By the early 2030s, we will be able to copy human consciousness to a computer. • Wireless Internet connection will be available anywhere on our planet. • All forms of transport will eventually become electric. • The effects of climate change will be irreversible. • Physical money (coins and notes) won't exist anymore. • Scientists will unlock the genetic secrets that could allow us to live for centuries, maybe forever.

message.content:
privacy is unlikely to vanish completely because people and laws will keep protecting privacy
consciousness copying into a computer is extremely unlikely by the early 2030s because the science is far from solving consciousness
wireless internet coverage everywhere on earth is plausible in parts but not truly anywhere by the near term because remote terrain oceans and cost will limit wireless
transport becoming fully electric is possible for many vehicles but not all transport because aviation shipping and heavy freight will remain non-electric transport
climate change effects will partly be irreversible yet some impacts can be mitigated and many outcomes remain uncertain making irreversible climate effects highly likely for some systems of climate
physical money will not vanish everywhere because some societies may keep using physical
life extension from genetic discoveries is likely modest but living for centuries or forever is extremely unlikely because aging is complex making life extension forever a fantasy life
